chose: a new PR action run is refused only while the previous run's command is still running; a started run stays re-clickable
over: refusing a new run while the previous one is started (D12)
because: nothing ends a started run but a token report, and restart, a new head and PR close all keep it live, so refusing re-clicks locks the action for good when a remote never reports; re-clicking is the operator's only escape
binding: none: this session owns no active work order
